sloka: तम् प्रहृष्टम् निधाय अंके रावणम् जनक आत्मजाम् ।गच्छंतम् खड्ग शेषम् च प्रणष्ट हत साधनम् ॥३-५१-२२॥
transliteration: tam prahṛṣṭam nidhāya aṁke rāvaṇam janaka ātmajām ।gacchaṁtam khaḍga śeṣam ca praṇaṣṭa hata sādhanam ॥3-51-22॥

translations.english: Seeing the lord of the flocks of birds exhausted due to age still fighting, Ravana felt glad. He flew back into the sky taking Sita, princess of Mithila, with him.
